detail.longDescription: I’m not talking about your grand ambitious SaaS startup or your mega open source project. Whats the favorite thing you’ve built just for you and your friends and family to use. I’ll start. Meem Makr is a lolcat maker featuring my actual cats. I use it every morning to tell the rest of the family when coffee is ready. https://apps.josh.earth/meem-makr/ WiFi QR code generator. Gives you a nicely formatted PDF. In browser. No ads. https://apps.josh.earth/wifi-qrcode/
